description: Pittston, PA - Congressman Rob Bresnahan today announced that he has earned the endorsement of Christina-Doherty Fraternal Order of Police Lodge #84, representing law enforcement officers across southern Luzerne County. Rep. Bresnahan has now earned the endorsement of seven FOP Lodges in Pennsylvania’s 8th district, as well as the Pennsylvania State Troopers Association.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Rob for PA
title: Bresnahan Earns Endorsement from 7th Fraternal Order of Police Lodge - Rob for PA
